title: Route tuning playbook: autopilot recommendations and staged rewind for batching/caching
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: build a robust, per-customer and per-route "autopilot" that suggests safe batching and caching adjustments and can apply them with staged rewind (safe rollback) if regressions appear. The feature should produce human-readable playbooks for operators and optionally apply low-risk changes automatically under policy-controlled guardrails.

Scope:
- Recommendation engine that ingests telemetry (token cost, P50/P95 latency, error rate, per-route QPS, cache hit ratio, KV cache efficiency) and outputs ranked suggestions: batching window, batch size caps, prefix/KV caching enablement, cache TTL, per-route allowlists/denylists, and tier-based presets.
- A simulation/dry-run mode that replays recent traffic against candidate configs to estimate cost delta and latency impact.
- Multi-stage apply workflow: dry-run -> canary (1-5% traffic) -> ramp (to target) with automated monitoring and staged rewind if regressions exceed thresholds.
- Safe defaults and tiered controls: Enterprise customers (gold/platinum) are exempt by default from aggressive batching; startups/standard tiers may receive more aggressive cost savings.
- UI hooks in Console: one-click view of suggested changes, confidence score, estimated monthly savings, and a link to run simulation or kick off canary.
- Auditability: every automatic or manual change must be logged with before/after config, metrics snapshot, and PR/approval reference.
- Denylists: per-route/tenant rules to exclude sensitive routes (LLM hallucination risk, structured-output endpoints) from autopilot changes.

Design notes:
- Recommendation signals will be normalized and z-scored per-route to avoid large customers drowning out small-tenant signals. Use per-customer heatmaps and sequence-length distributions to shape candidate batch sizes.
- For caching suggestions, prefer enabling prefix/KV caching when repeated prefixes > 5% and cache hit ratio expected > 20%. Propose TTLs based on observed reuse interval.
- Use historical median latency and tail latency windows to compute a safe delta budget; do not accept changes with >5% expected increase to P95 for routes with SLOs.
- Staged rewind strategy: early-stop if (error_rate increase > 40% of baseline) OR (P95 latency regresses > 2x or >100ms absolute) OR (user-configured signal thresholds). Rollback will attempt an automated revert and notify on-call and the tenant owner.

Integration points:
- Runtime: expose APIs to submit candidate config, start dry-run, and apply canary splits.
- Console: suggestion center, simulation runner, and canary monitor.
- Alerts: wire into existing tracing and SLO alerts; auto-create incident when staged rewind triggers.
- Audit: write change metadata to audit log (KMS-protected) and surface in customer-facing activity feed for Private customers.

Out-of-scope for initial MVP: per-customer machine learning model rewrites or automated quantization changes. MVP will focus on batching windows, batch size caps, caching toggles/TTLs, and tiered allowlist/denylist rules.
acceptance_criteria: System surfaces ranked recommendations for at least 80% of active routes based on one week of telemetry
Dry-run simulation produces an estimated delta in cost and latency and matches within 15% of observed impact after a real canary run
Canary apply path supports 1%, 5%, and 25% traffic splits with automated monitoring and staged rewind that reverts within 2 minutes of threshold breach
Console shows suggestion, confidence, estimated monthly savings, and links to run simulation and start canary
Audit logs record before/after configs, the actor (autopilot or user), and a simulation snapshot
Tier exemptions (gold/platinum) can be configured and respected by the autopilot
tasks: Spec recommendation model and scoring rules (signals + normalization)
Build simulation harness to replay traffic and estimate cost/latency impact
Runtime API: submit_candidate, start_dry_run, start_canary, finalize, staged_rewind
Console: suggestions list UI + simulation runner + canary monitor
Implement allowlist/denylist rule engine and per-tenant tier lookup
Write audit hooks and integrate with existing compliance logs
Create automated tests for staged rewind triggers and rollback correctness
Run rollout plan: internal canary -> opt-in beta customers -> gradual enablement
